NOTIFICATION FOR SELECTION OF MANAGING DIRECTOR THROUGH CONTRACTUAL/DEPUTATION
AT ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR STATE COOPERATIVE BANK LIMITED, HEAD OFFICE, SRI VIJAYA
PURAM.
The Andaman and Nicobar State Cooperative Bank Limited, Head Office, Sri Vijaya
Puram invites applications for selection to the post of Managing Director through
contractual/deputation from candidates who fulfil the following Fit and Proper Criteria
prescribed by RBI/NABARD.
1. Age:
The applicant shall not be above 56 years of age in case of deputation & shall not
be above 62 years of age as on the date of publication of this notification in case of
contractual.
2. Qualifications:
The person to be appointed as Managing Director through
contractual/deputation shall possess any of the following educational qualifications:
a) Graduate with CAIIB/DBF/Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or
equivalent qualification; or
b) Chartered/ cost accountant; or
c) Post Graduate in any discipline;
3. Scale of Pay:
The candidates selected through contractual basis shall have their salary fixed based
on their last salary drawn, whereas for candidates selected through deputation, their
salary shall be fixed at pay level-12 as per current 07th CPC.
4. Experience:
The applicant shall have at least eight (08) years work experience at the
middle/senior level in the Banking Sector. Senior/Middle level for the purpose shall be
taken as the third level (Scale/cadre) onwards [i.e., excluding the first two levels
(scales/cadres) in the Officer cadre], or as the highest two levels (scales/cadres) below
the level of Managing Director.
5. General conditions:
i. The applicant shall not be above 56 years of age in the case of appointment on
deputation and shall not be above 62 years of age in the case of contractual
appointment, as on the date of publication of this notification. However, the
maximum age limit for continuation in the post shall be 65 years, subject to
applicable regulatory requirements.
ii. The appointment shall be subject to approval of RBI as per NABARD Circular ref:
NB.IDD/284-669/Coop Policy/2024-25 dt. 03.07.2024, NABARD fit and proper
criteria ref No: RPCD.RCBD 137/03.01.03/2011-12 and Master Direction in
Governance issued by RBI Ref: DOR.GOV.REC.No.217/18-10-015/2025-26 dt:
28.11.2025.
iii. The application should be submitted in the prescribed format only.
iv. The last date for receipt of application in hard-copy and by signed scanned copy
through email (info@anscbank.in) by 06.11.2026 (up to 05:00 PM).
v. The applicant shall have to disclose the information relating to the disciplinary
actions pending/proposed and punishments awarded or any penalties pending
against he/she thereof, if any.
vi. Applications not complying with the conditions of Age, Qualifications,
Experience, fees, employer recommendations etc., will be summarily rejected.
vii. A recent passport size photo is to be pasted on the application in the space
provided.
viii. Application should be accompanied by self-attested true copies of certificates
pertaining to proof of date of birth, qualifications, experience and other
credentials.
ix. Application along with the general conditions can be downloaded from the Bank’s
website www.anscb.bank.in.
x. Candidates fulfilling the Fit & Proper Criteria prescribed by the RBI/NABARD
presently working in other Banks should apply through Proper Channel. They
may submit advance copies before the last date, to avoid any delay in forwarding
of their applications.
xi. In case of candidates who have resigned or taken voluntary retirement from
service, other-wise eligible as per the Fit & Proper Criteria, they have to submit
their relieving certificate and other relevant records required for the purpose
along with the application.
xii. Interested candidates may submit their application form in hard-copy and by
signed scanned copy through email (info@anscbank.in) in the prescribed format
mentioned in Annexure-A within due date, enclosing all self-attested
supporting relevant documents and testimonials along with a latest passport size
photo in sealed envelope bearing the superscription “Application for the post
of Managing Director on contractual/deputation, Andaman and
Nicobar State Cooperative Bank Limited” address to The General
Manager(Dev.)(i/c), Head Office, Andaman and Nicobar State Cooperative Bank
Limited, Post Box No. 289, 98, Maulana Azad Road, Sri Vijaya Puram, A & N
Islands- 744101.
Sd/-
Chairman
Dated: 16.10.2026
